title: Decide how a figure is stored: existing MediaAsset and attachments, or a new record
description: Design first, with Ryan's review. A figure has rendered images in both themes, an editable source (SVG and figure.json), who approved it and when, and belongs to a Story across versions. Compare extending MediaAsset plus ModelAttachment with a new Figure model. Name its readers: the newsroom, the context pack, the render tool, the fact check, carry-forward to new versions. Prefer what exists unless it cannot hold approval history.
